reviews_5s: Constantly grating cheeses, zesting lemons, these handheld options allow great versatility. Love the pair and the price was great. Very well made and fit in a drawer nearby. Very much appreciate the ability to grate into the cover that comes with it as well.Wonderful tools for the kitchen, good quality for a nice price! Easy to clean and easy to use.The best zester ever, easy to useThese graters are perfect for me. They are sturdy, easy to hold or use while set down on the counter. They are very sharp and do not rust. They are easy to clean. I wash them by hand and have not put them in the dishwasher since I have an older dishwasher that might not clean all the grater edges. Also, they grate huge amount of Parmesan cheese extremely quickly, evenly and easily. I hardy have to apply pressure. In a few seconds I have a large pile of fresh Parmesan. I use the plastic covers to safely store the graters in a drawer. The covers fit perfectly and securely. I don’t use the covers to catch the grated cheese because they don’t hold much and the graters work so quickly and easily and just holding them upright in a bowl produces much more than the plastic covers could hold. I think they are very reasonably priced and extremely well made.I always grate my own cheese, this makes it so light and fluffy the cheese lasts much longer. It looks like you are using more cheese than you actually are but the food tastes the same. Do be careful not to grate your fingers as it is very sharp, but I think it's wonderful and bought for my kids too.Not that a grater needs to be attractive, but these do have a nice look. Nice and long and sizing is perfect. It's a buy.Perfect zesterDoes a nice slicing and shreddingDo not put the clear plastic cover in the dishwasher. It will warp if you do.Use both all the time - has built in protective shield that also serves as a catch for when you grate things.
